title: Vận hành — Tổng quan
prompt: Design the operations workspace dashboard in Vietnamese: active donation drives, awaiting intake counts, independent reviews, stock exceptions, open needs, distributions in progress and reconciliation highlights. Each card links to an actual workflow; permission-scoped controls for campaign manager/intake/reviewer/distribution staff. Responsive operational shell and calm palette. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

title: Vận hành — Quản lý đợt quyên góp

No financial collection. Vietnamese responsive web and operational shell. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

title: Vận hành — Tiếp nhận và kiểm đếm
